title: Introduction to non-Abelian Patchworking
summary: The note introduces a novel concept of non-Abelian patchworking arising as real locus of non-Abelian complex-phase tropical hypersurfaces, the theory of which is now developed enough to allow the proposed spin-off. Although, non-Abelian Tropical Geometry makes sense for an arbitrary reductive complex group, the state of the art is that of full understanding of tropicalizations of surfaces within three dimensional groups $PGL_2(\mathbb{C})$ and $SL_2(\mathbb{C}),$ which are closely related via the two-fold covering.
